CONTRIBUTING.md and PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: failed-seed sentences say what run 44550679481 showed and did not. Checks after the last edit, each exit 0: check 27 of 27, its selftest 63/63, gate-parity and its selftest 135/135, targeted sweep 6/6 files 994 cases, prove-gates --list and verify.sh --list unchanged since stage one, ruff clean, full sweep 198/198 files 19534 cases.
